public_rationale: He said none of the arrangement would happen: an OpenAI lease of SB Energy's 10GW Ohio campus, backed by NVIDIA, followed by an SB Energy IPO built on the contract. Three weeks later, on August 17, 2026, OpenAI signed a 20-year lease for the Pike County campus. NVIDIA agreed to guarantee up to $105 billion of lease payments and to invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy. On September 1, SB Energy filed for a US IPO. The guarantee was smaller than the $250 billion reported in July. The campus is not built, and the IPO had not closed by October 28. But he made a categorical 'any of this' denial, and the central deal did happen. His warnings about construction and debt may still prove right, but the forecast as worded is contradicted.
limitations: The deal terms differ from the July reports (a $105B guarantee, not $250B). The $350B chip financing is unconfirmed.
The IPO was filed but not completed. Construction is at an early stage.
A reader who takes 'this' to mean only the finished 10GW build-out would treat the claim as still open.

from_speaker: Will any of this happen? God no.
SB Energy ... to raise debt to build a 10GW data center
by getting a backstop from NVIDIA
If/when this deal closes, SoftBank ... will use the contract signed with OpenAI as a way to take SB Energy public
our_interpretation: "This" is the arrangement described just before: OpenAI leasing SB Energy's roughly 10GW Ohio campus, with NVIDIA backing the financing, and SoftBank then using the OpenAI contract to take SB Energy public.

"Any of this" is a categorical denial. On a plain reading, a signed and announced lease with NVIDIA credit support is a core part of 'this' and would contradict it. The speaker does not need to be wrong about every step (finished build-out, $350B chip financing, completed IPO) for the denial to fail.
Exact dollar figures from the July press reports ($250B guarantee, $350B chip financing) are not required. The deal can happen on smaller terms and still be the deal he described.
No deadline was given, so the claim can only be settled early by a decisive dated event.
criteria.support_condition: The OpenAI–SB Energy Ohio lease talks collapse, or NVIDIA declines to back the financing, and no SB Energy IPO built on an OpenAI contract goes ahead.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A signed, announced agreement under which OpenAI leases the SB Energy Ohio campus with NVIDIA financial backing. A further sign would be SB Energy moving to go public using that contract.
